title: the inference domain answers for its migration over the bus
intention: inference_domain answers a bus verb `migration` with {old_table_gone, leaves, dump_spent, dump_avoided, dump_newest}, read on its own box, so a proof on any box can ask the home instance instead of its own leaf count.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 on akienasus: 98ab0e9db57f tooth 7 reds '17 leaves in the answer tree' because it reads this box's store and dump; the answer tree is one box's (open-39f6229e7241, outline 5.5.3.8, 11.3.5.1), and e95b5d93cff0's bounds keep inference_domain's code out, so the reading needs a verb at the address that owns it (RULE 1; orchestrator ruling 'e95b A' via a sibling ticket).
traces_to: RULE 1 (a device is reached only through its bus); Law 8 (a proof reads the same on every box).
how: migrate_answers_to_their_tree.report() reads the old table's registration and presence, the answer tree's leaf count, and the newest dump's COPY section (miss cost spent, hit cost avoided, newest created); device.py declares `migration` and returns report()'s dict JSON-safe. The report lives in the migration module because tooth 1 of 98ab0e9db57f allows only that module to name the old table.

clauses.claim: with the old table gone and a dump standing, the migration verb answers old_table_gone true, the tree's leaf count, and the dump's spent, avoided and newest created
with the old table still registered or present, old_table_gone is false
with no dump standing, dump_spent, dump_avoided and dump_newest are null, and the verb still answers
the device declares the verb migration, and device.py still names no old table

decisions.text: D1: report() in the migration module reads the store and the newest dump under the instance's temp.
D2: device.py declares `migration`, its handler returns report() JSON-safe.
D3: the proof fakes the store and writes a scratch dump, one tooth per clause.

measured.saw: AssertionError: 17 leaves in the answer tree
measured.how: bin/cairn test over the proxy proof on akienasus (e95b5d93cff0's measured)

measured.saw: declared_verbs is resolve, embed, infer, calls; no verb reports the migration
